reviews.x: The 2-1 flosser was an excellent purchase I have ever made. The price was outstanding and it have several features including a timer to let you know how long you been brushing, it makes sure your child is brushing and flossing for the necessary time.  It comes with USB cord to charge. If you do alot of traveling it has its own velvet travel, charging station and tooth brush and water pick flosser. GREAT/EXCELLENT

reviews.t: Teeth and gums feel great after using!
reviews.x: My mouth feels great after using the flosser. Definitely encourages me to do it more often. I had one before with the reservoir attached and it was harder to use due to the bulkiness of it. This is a lot easier to hold although I did fumble with the hose attachment the first few times. Now I’ve gotten the hang of how much water I need in the cup and attaching the hose to the cup. Looking forward to my next cleaning to see if I’m doing a good job

I have been looking for an electric tooth brush and water flosser. Came across this one that has both!  One less item to pack if I needed to travel! It was very easy to set up, and it worked very well. It cleans  so much better than regular tooth brush!
Good value and seems to do a good job . The water flosser is a little awkward to use but still  better than two pieces of equipment . Good choice so far.
I use it for the deep cleaning, I love it It is easy to use for all ages.

I bought this item in March, 2021, and it worked reasonable well until September 9, 2021 when it just went dead. It was properly charged but I tried to see if it needed to be charged but it showed no signs of life. That day I sent an email Hogar Tech explaining the situation and the fact that the product had a year's warranty and barely 5 months had passed before it broke down. I received no answer to this day. I had been using this for almost a month now. I am so pleased with it. It saves time with flossing, really convenient to use and easy to take when you travel. I received 2 flosser with it though I wish it had been 2 tooth brush instead. And it is so reasonably priced. So I have to update: works well for 10 months. All lights are on fully charged and just won't work. Warranty of 2 yrs. is useless.

I always use a floss and been wanting to try a water floss. When I first tried it, the water sprayed at me randomly, Lol. However, I watched a couple videos of how to to use a water floss, I had no problems after. I started with high and it was too strong at the beginning, but after a few times of using, high works pretty good for me. Overall I would recommend it.

This electric toothbrush and dental flosser are 2 in one, so I can reduce the number of visits to the dentist!  You can choose between regular cleaning and deep cleaning.  Equipped with two floss heads and a convenient bag to carry around!  I like the user-friendly package!
This thing is badass...Fully charge it until light is green, hook up the tunes and if you don't get water sip on it like a straw and it will help the pressure!

Great toothbrush power, the water flosser feature is also strong enough to get whatever gunk out of your teeth. When your using the water flosser for the first time or let it sit for a while before using it again, the water takes a few seconds to come out.  Update July 2021- this wasn't what I thought it would be. Did not last long at all. Motor is faulty. Toothbrush head is very cheap, the bristles started to spurt out did not keep their shape. reviews.t: Works well for toothbrush or floss, but not both
reviews.x: I was really excited to get this flosser and electric toothbrush. The water flosser is something I've been looking at for a long time, and wasn't sure if I wanted to take a risk on it. I will say that it does work. You have to fill a cup of water, and attach the flosser accessory, along with the rubber tube. It's a little messy at first, but is easy to figure out.  I personally stopped using this for the flosser because I like the toothbrush attachment better, and switching back and forth is too

This is Christmas gift for myself. I would highly recommend this to anyone who would like to improve their dental hygiene. It is flossing my teeth very clean. The battery life is pretty good. The pressure levels are strong enough to clean the teeth .This is one of those products that once you have, you could never imagine living without it again.

My dentist recommended me water flosser to improve my gum lines & plague control. So i ordered this & its definitely has a positive effect on my gums. After using regularly my gums feel better and i have noticed less sensitivity to chilled & warm foods items & drinks. The only thing is it can be messy to use.

reviews.t: Great for traveling and small space
reviews.x: I bought it for a small bathroom to replace the one with a tank. I wasn't sure if it would work as efficiently. Just tried it last night, it's nice. It replaced both my water flosser with a tank and the toothbrush. It saves so much counter space, and still powerful enough to do the job.

Space saving, nice power. My only issue is, it doesn't like to switch from flosser to brush at times. It does a nice job at cleaning though. I have had an issue with sensitivity after using it with water that was too cold, my fault not the tools. Overall, would recommend.

Well I guess I am screwed i was in the middle of moving didn't use it right away now my return window has expired.  It doesn't work it runs but nothing comes out.  So if you buy this product be sure you ready to check it out right away just in case it doesn't work.

reviews.t: Lots of bang for your buck!
reviews.x: I really like how well it works and how easy it is to use, but the handle is wobbly in the stand, which makes it hard to keep good contact when charging. I am contacting the seller and will update if the problem is resolved. Otherwise, it is an excellent product!

reviews.t: Just what I was looking for!
reviews.x: I’ve been looking for a single unit for brushing and a water jet that wasn’t huge.  Here it is. It’s a little awkward with the water line to a cup, but much more likely to be actually used because it is already in your hand!  It is powerful and does the job well.

After a couple of months the water pick feature quit then the pulsing toothbrush feature.  Made a lot of noise but nothing worked.  I tried all the solutions to make it work listed in the booklet to no avail.  Absolute waste of money.  Just had to throw it away.

I have been using YaFex flosser for a week, and I like it. This is my first water flosser, nothing to compare with, but it works really good for me so far. Very strong pressure, water blasts fast and hard. Battery lasts a week with no problem.

The bristles on the tooth brush is not good I started using in December and I need a replacement already. The switch from pic to tooth brush gets stuck I have to bang it on the sink to get it to switch on. I do not recommend this product

This item did not work, the water would not come out and it made a grinding noise. I sent it back via Kohl's and my account says a refund was issued on April 6 but no refund has been issued to my bank account

reviews.t: Comfortable to use, cleans teeth good, compact,
reviews.x: This flosser is perfect for my needs.  Cleans between my teeth without making my gums uncomfortable.  Easy to use.  Packed easily in my bag on my trip.  Takes up little space on my sink.  I highly recommend.

I got the one with the tank last year and when my husband asked for a new toothbrush I decided to get him this. I love this set, the heads are easy to replace and my teeth always feel great after use.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the 2-in-1 toothbrush and water flosser design as convenient and space-saving, replacing separate devices.
Many customers find it easy to use and good for travel, though some note a learning curve with the hose or water spraying initially.
Several reviewers report improved dental hygiene results, including cleaner teeth and better-feeling gums.
The product is widely considered good value for the price.
A few reviewers report problems, including a unit that stopped working and one noting it works for toothbrush or floss but not both.
